title: Best autofarm
features:
[Imp Hub X - Dragon Ball Rage] V1.25 Complete Rework

[Main Changes]
[-] Switched Key System -> "luarmor.net"
[-] Migrated to Obsidian UI Library (improved performance & stability)
[-] Complete source code optimization & refactor
[-] Dragon Ball ESP system overhaul

[Training]
• Auto Train Strength Toggle
• Auto Train Defense Toggle
• Auto Train Ki Toggle
• Train Speed Slider (0.1-10 seconds)
• Auto Release Key Toggle
• Safe Training Mode Toggle (prevents multi-train conflicts)
• Real-time Stats Display (Attack, Defense, Ki, Agility, Power Level)
• Refresh Stats Button
• Auto-updating stats every 2 seconds

[Energy Management]
• Auto Charge Energy Toggle
• Charge At % Slider (5-50%)
• Stop At % Slider (50-100%)
• Reset Character Button (fix movement bugs)
• Energy threshold tracking (prevents stalling)

[Farming]
• Farm Status Display (Status, Current Mob, Health %)
• Mob Selection Dropdown (Multi-Select)
• Farm Mode Dropdown (Selected, Closest, Random)
• Check Power Level Toggle (only farm weaker mobs)
• Auto Farm Mobs Toggle
• Teleport Position Dropdown (Front, Above, Below)
• Teleport Type Dropdown (Default, Tween)
• Attack Delay Slider (0-2 seconds)
• Fast Attack Toggle (removes delay - risky)
• Try Dodge Teleport Toggle (intelligent evasion)
• Dodge Pattern Dropdown (Circle, Square, Figure 8, Spiral)
• Dodge Radius Slider (2-10 studs)
• Dodge Speed Slider (5-45 degrees/tick)
• Semi Insta Kill Toggle (finish low HP mobs)
• Bring Mobs Toggle (teleport nearby mobs to you)
• Auto Attack Toggle

[Powers]
• Power Selection Dropdown (Multi-Select)
• Auto Use Powers Toggle
• Use Power Delay Slider (5-100 seconds)
• Power equipping automation

[Quests]
• Current Quest Status Display
• Quest Selection Dropdown
• Auto Claim Quest Toggle
• Auto Claim Power Quest Toggle (claim based on power level).

& 30+ Features
